status: First-round modern direction superseded by user feedback: restore the retro diner personality. See round-2.

assets.a-gavel.png: Simplified orange gavel. Most direct FoodJury and courtroom association. Hero, thinking and celebrating poses.
assets.b-dumpling.png: Cream dumpling in a navy judicial robe. Warm food association. Hero, thinking and celebrating poses.
assets.c-fox.png: Orange fox in a navy judicial cape. Clever editorial personality. Hero, thinking and celebrating poses.
assets.app-design-concept.png: Proposed Home, Build a Case and Verdict layouts. Uses gavel provisionally, pending mascot choice. Sample food data.

recommendation: A: the gavel directly expresses the name and retains continuity while simplifying the character.

refinement_notes.a: Retain expressive eyebrows and T silhouette; flatten residual shading in production art.
refinement_notes.b: Retain the three broad crown pleats. Standardize gavel size and robe shape across all poses.
refinement_notes.c: Keep the knowing expression friendly; simplify tail and remove grain for tiny placements.

next_after_selection: Refine chosen character based on user feedback.
Develop a face-led app icon with a simple opaque background and no text.
Verify the icon at launcher sizes before exporting platform assets.
Build consistent transparent character poses after the design is accepted.
implementation: Exploration only. No existing app code or installed assets changed.
user_feedback: The app lost its retro and fun diner identity and looked like a simple modern app.
